title: National Mission on Edible Oil-Oil Palm – Target Regions
subject: Geography
caption: Map of India highlighting NE states and Andaman & Nicobar Islands targeted for oil palm cultivation under the National Mission on Edible Oil.
altText: A high‑resolution educational textbook illustration of India on a white background, with the North‑Eastern states (Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura) and the Andaman & Nicobar Islands colored bright green. All state borders are outlined in black, each highlighted region is clearly labelled, and a legend explains that the green shading indicates target areas for oil palm cultivation under the National Mission on Edible Oil. A scale bar and inset map of the Indian Ocean are also included.
